answers.what: Deeper is a free add-on for AI chat tools that helps you ask better, more expert-style questions.
answers.does: It rewrites your request to include sensible steps, useful tools, starting information, and ways to check the result. It shows you the rewritten prompt first and waits for your approval before doing anything.
answers.who: It seems intended for anyone using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or a coding tool who wants a more thorough answer, even if they are not an expert.
answers.next: Go to deeper.tools/start, copy its instructions into your AI chat, then type “/deeper” followed by your request.

answers.what: Deeper is a free add-on for AI chat tools that rewrites your request to sound more like one written by an expert.
answers.does: It aims to help the AI use your facts, work more expertly, check its answer, and follow what you asked. The video reports better scores in a small five-request test, but that alone does not prove it will always improve answers.
answers.who: It seems to be for people using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or coding AI tools who want help writing better requests; the video does not say that you need technical experience.
answers.next: Go to deeper.tools/start, copy Deeper’s instructions, and paste them into ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. Then type “/deeper” followed by your request.
